option.config-modes.auto.label: Auto
option.config-modes.auto.hint: Reads the assigned pack and sets format, sample rate, channels and buffer for you.
option.config-modes.manual.label: Manual
option.config-modes.manual.hint: Lets you set every one of them by hand.
section.volume.title: Volume
master-volume.label: Master Volume
master-volume.description: Controls the overall game volume, so it affects all audio output
per-group-volume.label: Independent Music / SFX
per-group-volume.description: Mix music and sound effects separately.
music-volume.label: Music Volume
music-volume.description: Sets the music level, for the original soundtrack and any music pack
ambient-volume.label: Ambience Volume
ambient-volume.description: Sets the level of the rain, waterfalls and wind played by a pack
sfx-volume.label: SFX Volume
section.msu.title: Music Packs
section.msu-mode.title: Replacement music
msu-config-mode.label: Configuration
msu-config-mode.description: Auto matches the assigned pack. Manual lets you set each option.
enable-msu.label: Pack Format
enable-msu.description: MSU, Deluxe, OPUZ or Deluxe OPUZ. Auto reads it from the pack.
resume-msu.label: Resume Tracks
resume-msu.description: Returning to an area picks its music up where it left off instead of restarting.
reset-msu-at-title.label: Reset At Title Screen
reset-msu-at-title.description: Reaching the title screen forgets every remembered position, so a new run starts with fresh music.
section.msu-sounds.title: Replacement sounds
pack-replace-ambient.label: Replace Ambient Sounds
pack-replace-ambient.description: Lets a pack take over the looping background sounds: rain, waterfalls, the hum of a dungeon.
pack-replace-sfx.label: Replace Sound Effects
pack-replace-sfx.description: Lets a pack take over the one-shot effects: bonks, explosions, menu blips.
section.playback.title: Audio Device
audio-freq.label: Sample Rate
audio-freq.description: Output rate: 44100 Hz for MSU/Deluxe, 48000 Hz for OPUZ.
audio-channels.label: Channels
audio-samples.label: Buffer Size
